lessons.title: Fixture Orientation Tour
lessons.description: Synthetic orientation tour over development-fixture geometry. It verifies canonical axes and selection flows and does not represent human anatomy.

steps.title: The central column
steps.instruction: Start at the Fixture Trunk Column on the midline (X = 0).

steps.title: Superior block
steps.instruction: Move superiorly (+Y) to the Fixture Head Block.

steps.title: Patient-left assembly
steps.instruction: Patient-left is +X in canonical space; this assembly is two geometry segments that select as one structure.

steps.title: Support plane
steps.instruction: The base plate sits at Y = 0, the canonical support plane.
